caption:
Costa Rica generates over 98% of its electricity from renewable sources, drawing primarily on hydropower, geothermal energy, wind, and solar.

While transport infrastructure changes in the Central Valley, the mountain ridges of the Talamanca and the dirt corridors of Nicoya remain defined by long days on foot, bike, and trail.
